WHO WE ARE

Built with purpose.
Driven by commitment.

An integrated construction and project delivery company built on quality, accountability, and collaboration.

OUR BACKSTORY

A foundation of experience.
A broader ambition.

Founded in 2018 as Alandulos Decoration & Construction, our journey began with a clear focus on quality, commitment, and dependable project delivery. As our capabilities and ambitions grew, we evolved into Black Construction.

Over the years, our experience has expanded across construction, fit-out, renovation, and specialized works, strengthening our ability to manage projects with greater control, coordination, and efficiency.

Today, we combine hands-on experience with a structured approach to project delivery. Our evolution reflects the continuous development of our capabilities, our team, and the standards we bring to every project.

OUR MISSION

Reliable delivery.
Lasting value.

To deliver reliable, high-quality construction solutions through disciplined execution, technical expertise, and effective project management.

We maintain clear control over quality, cost, schedule, and safety. Hands-on experience, strong coordination, and a client-focused approach help us deliver projects that meet their objectives.

OUR VISION

Trusted today.
Ready for tomorrow.

To build Black Construction into a trusted and recognized name in Saudi Arabia’s construction sector.

We grow through consistent performance, strong partnerships, and the continuous development of our people and capabilities—taking on increasingly complex projects while maintaining quality, reliability, and accountability.
